(4 items) Adds 3-129 Weapon and Spell Damage

(5 items) When you deal damage with a Dawn's Wrath ability, you gain a stack of Sunlight for |cffffff15|r seconds, once per attack and up to |cffffff30|r times. Each stack grants |cffffff21|r Magicka Recovery. When at max stacks, stacks no longer refresh, your Templar skill line abilities deal |cffffff25|r% bonus damage but is reduced to |cffffff10|r% against players, and a Wrathful Nova is cast on the enemy.

When Sunlight expires at max stacks, you lose |cffffff50|r% of your current Magicka.
